releaseNotes:
- Parallel download/upload workers (ask how many, each takes whole files, then verify)
- In-app transfer report with live per-worker slots (does not lock other Windows apps)
- Type-to-search in the FTP tree and Direct Upload path list
- Mapped folder download with overwrite confirm and cancelable progress
- Fixes: scrollbar drag, open-file Error dialog, editor arrow keys, worker count stuck at 2W
